:::{#exm-preimage}
#### The preimage of a set of doubled die rolls

For the [function](#def-function) $f : \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6} \to \reals$ with $f(a) = 2a$ from @exm-function,
the [preimage](#def-preimage) of $\set{4, 6}$ is $\set{2, 3}$,
because $f(2) = 4$ and $f(3) = 6$.
The preimage of $\set{3}$ is the [empty set](sets.qmd#def-empty-set),
because $2a = 3$ has no solution among the die rolls.

:::
